title: Monkey with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='40' r='13' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='40' r='13' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='40' r='8' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='40' r='8' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#F0C896'/>
  <!-- forehead highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='18' ry='11' fill='#A0704A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#2E1A0E'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='48' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#2E1A0E'/>
  <!-- eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='38.5' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- tiny star sparkles -->
  <polygon points='44,42 45,44 47,44 45.5,45.5 46,48 44,46.5 42,48 42.5,45.5 41,44 43,44' fill='#FFFFAA'/>
  <polygon points='64,42 65,44 67,44 65.5,45.5 66,48 64,46.5 62,48 62.5,45.5 61,44 63,44' fill='#FFFFAA'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#C07850'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='55.5' rx='1.2' ry='1' fill='#A06040'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='55.5' rx='1.2' ry='1' fill='#A06040'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M42 62 Q50 70 58 62' stroke='#6B3A1E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='58' r='4' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='58' r='4' fill='#E8A0A0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- hair tuft -->
  <path d='M46 20 Q50 12 54 20' stroke='#6B3A1E' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 18 Q52 10 54 18' stroke='#6B3A1E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='20' ry='15' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#F0C896'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M32 78 Q20 88 16 80' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 78 Q80 88 84 80' stroke='#8B5E3C' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='80' r='4' fill='#D4A574'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='80' r='4' fill='#D4A574'/>
</svg>
